_comment: ngsolve nonlinear_elasticity#2 (Neo-Hookean 'Tr(C) - d'). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: dropping '- d' shifts a.Energy(0) from exactly 0.0 to 0.5*mu*d*|Omega|, but because it is an additive constant its Variation is identically zero -- a.Apply at u=0 gives Norm(res)=0.0 for BOTH forms, Newton takes the same iteration count, and the converged coefficient vectors are bitwise identical. So the W(F=I)=0 sanity check is real while the claimed 'non-zero initial stress / Newton runs off' consequence is not.
